questions.expected_answer: Specify measures such as verified rescue outcomes, people awaiting safe processing, occupancy versus supported capacity, completed authorised transfers and validated installation/protection status. Assign reporting and verification responsibility, confirm who will sustain remaining care and submit thresholds or observation periods for approval. Reduce support only against the approved condition and handover decision.
